Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated GPU capacity "Gauntlet" — request to schedule architecture walkthrough

Hi Hannah / Marissa,

Thanks again for the intro call last week. Our infra + SRE team at FinWave would like a focused architecture walkthrough on Redwood's Dedicated capacity to validate pool sizing, autoscale behavior under burst, and tenant isolation guarantees before we move to an evaluation commitment.

High-level asks:
- Review recommended pool sizing for 100k concurrent inference requests/day (80/20 chat vs batch).
- Autoscaling stabilizers (ramp, cooldown, scale-up limits) and cost implications.
- How isolation is enforced across tenants and options for strict isolation for regulatory workloads.
- Fallback routing & soft-fallback model variants during constrained capacity.

Can we book a 60–75 minute technical session next week (PST)? Our preferred times:
- Tue 25 May 10:00–11:15 PT
- Wed 26 May 13:00–14:15 PT

I attached our short capacity spreadsheet and the initial POI. If these slots don't work, please propose alternatives.

Thanks,
Alice
Alice R.
